summary: Iteration 13 regression — iteration 12 HIGH bug (buyer tab bar leaking PAYOUTS/ADD-ITEM/INVENTORY) is FIXED. Buyer tab bar now renders EXACTLY 4 tabs: DISCOVER · TRY ON · ATELIER · PROFILE (verified via role=tab query AND screenshot at 390x844 mobile viewport). Seller tab bar still correct: INVENTORY · ANALYTICS · ORDERS · SETTINGS. Top-level redirect files (/app/frontend/app/{inventory,add-item,payouts}.tsx) work: unauthenticated visits to /inventory, /add-item, /payouts all resolve to /welcome (via RBAC bounce through /(seller) layout). Logged in as seller, the same deep-links render the seller inventory dashboard, the add-item wizard, and the payouts management page respectively (confirmed by screenshots). Logged in as buyer, the same deep-links bounce to /(tabs) (Discover home) — buyer never sees any seller UI. Backend smoke (POST /api/user/toggle-role seller→buyer→seller) passes 1/1.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — clean: only the 4 spec Tabs.Screen entries (index, tryon, atelier, profile). RBAC bounce intact (admin→/admin, seller→/(seller), anon→/welcome).

/app/frontend/app/{inventory,add-item,payouts}.tsx — minimal 4-line redirect components at the top level using <Redirect href=...>. Correctly resolve through /(seller) RBAC which then bounces buyers back to /(tabs) and anonymous users to /welcome — no buyer ever sees the seller routes.
Verified via [role=tab] DOM query that no leaked tab labels exist on the buyer side at /.
